strategy_description: Hold SPY when the lagged Retail Inventories-to-Sales Ratio signal is favorable (low/easing); else cash.
lead_description: Signal is lagged 6 month(s) before allocation.
notes: A high inventories-to-sales ratio signals weakening demand and precedes equity weakness. On this sample the raw level is NOT stationary (ADF does not reject a unit root; KPSS rejects stationarity) — it drifts — so level signals use 60-month ROLLING-percentile thresholds as adaptive regime filters rather than fixed cutoffs. Winner (level/T_roll_p50) is selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window (1998-01-31 to 2017-05-31) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window; still a search-selected rule — read as found-in-search.

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start)) monthly mean/std*sqrt(12); winner evaluated on OOS window

is_window.rule: common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date across all grid candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the published grid; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: Pre-GH#251 OOS-argmax selection, comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261016.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only
